- Added chat preview actions to context menus, so you can now preview chats from the chat list and Saved Messages sublists
- Added drag reordering to the proxy list, so you can now arrange proxies using their drag handles
- Fixed an issue with deleting proxies that previously caused an adjacent proxy to lose its rotation preference
- Improved window transitions on Windows 10, macOS and Linux, which now preserve the background in ordinary windows
- Fixed an issue with message details at the top of context menus that previously caused the separator between read or reaction details and edited or forwarded timestamps to disappear
- Improved image and file downloads, which now start sooner when you resume browsing after a short pause

---

- 新增了右键菜单中的聊天预览入口，现在可以从聊天列表和收藏夹子会话列表预览聊天
- 新增了代理列表拖动排序功能，现在可以通过拖动柄调整代理顺序
- 修复了删除代理时，相邻代理的轮换偏好被一并清除的问题
- 改善了 Windows 10、macOS 和 Linux 的窗口切换动画，使普通窗口在过渡期间保留背景
- 修复了消息详情置于右键菜单顶部时，已读或回应信息与编辑或转发时间之间缺少分隔线的问题
- 改善了图片和文件下载的启动速度，减少短暂停留后继续浏览时的等待
